items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: So he came over to me, and we were sitting and talking one day

ctx.x: Cannonball. Cannonball Adderly. So he came over to me, and we were sitting and talking one day, so he was kidding me, he said, 'Who came first, Russell Procope or Benny Carter?' You know. That sort of thing is -- it's all right, I guess, you know.
It's strange, you know, that you being around, that they didn't get you.
